Canned Vegetables & Dried Fruits: Canned fruit and vegetables keep for months at room temperature and give kitchens the same quality all year, whatever the season. This range covers Acroyali canned fruit (peach and pear halves, lychees, fruit cocktail, dark sweet cherries and glacé cherries) and canned vegetables and pulses (sweet corn, cream-style corn, young corn, straw and whole mushrooms, baked beans and red kidney beans) and capers. Hotels, restaurants and bakeries use them for buffets, pizza, salads, desserts and baking.
Chocolate & Pastry: Ingredients for bakeries, cafés and pastry kitchens: cocoa powder and cocoa butter for chocolate work, almond paste and praline cream for fillings, instant dry yeast for bread and pizza dough, almond milk, rice paper, and Mavee's cooking cream and sweetened whipping creams for sauces, cake decoration and desserts.
Dry Nuts, Seeds & Dried Fruits: Nuts, seeds, grains and dried fruit for baking, desserts, salads and breakfast menus: whole, sliced and ground almonds, walnut halves, pecans, pine nuts, pumpkin and sunflower seed kernels, white and black quinoa, dried apricots and sultanas. Nuts are rich in oil, so they keep their flavour best stored airtight in a cool, dry place away from light.
Edible Oils: Sunflower oil for professional kitchens: an everyday oil for frying and cooking.
Flour: Specialty flours for kitchens and bakeries: fine corn flour for thickening sauces and soups and for crisp coatings, and a gluten-free bread flour mix for breads, rolls and bases on gluten-free menus. Tempura flour and panko breadcrumbs are in Japanese Products.
Frozen French Fries: Frozen French fries from Hungritos, stored and delivered under cold chain at −18 °C: a 9 mm straight cut for everyday sides, and coated 7 mm shoestring fries with a crunchy finish for burgers and fried-seafood baskets. Cook them straight from frozen; fries that thaw before frying soak up oil and turn limp.
Frozen Fruit Puree: DIRA fruit purees from Dirafrost, kept frozen at −18 °C: mango, passion fruit, strawberry, raspberry, lemon and coconut. Purees give bars, cafés and pastry kitchens the same flavour and colour all year for cocktails, smoothies, mousses, sorbets, sauces and glazes, without peeling, pitting or straining fruit. Thaw in the refrigerator and use within the time on the pack.
Frozen Meat: Frozen beef, lamb and mutton for hotels, restaurants and caterers: beef striploin, tenderloin, topside and short rib, beef pepperoni, lamb leg on the bone and boneless, frenched lamb rack and lamb shoulder slices, and mutton leg and cubes. Every cut is stored and delivered at −18 °C. Thaw meat slowly in the refrigerator, never at room temperature, and cook it once thawed.
Frozen Potato Products: Hungritos frozen potato products beyond fries: hash browns for breakfast service and thick-cut potato wedges for sides and starters, with the fries listed under Frozen French Fries. Kept at −18 °C and cooked from frozen, by deep-frying or in the oven.
Frozen Vegetables & Fruits: Frozen vegetables from Damaco (broccoli, cauliflower, Brussels sprouts, green peas and a peas, carrot and corn mix) and frozen berries from DIRA (blueberries, raspberries, cranberries, blackcurrants and red currants). Frozen lines let kitchens serve vegetables and fruit that are out of season or not grown in Sri Lanka, with no trimming waste. Delivered at −18 °C.
Herbs & Spices: Dried herbs and spices for kitchens: shredded basil, oregano and thyme, chopped rosemary, whole bay leaves and sumac powder, the Mediterranean and Middle Eastern seasonings behind pizza and pasta sauces, roasts, grills and salads. Dried herbs give their best flavour when added early in cooking, and keep longest sealed, cool and away from light.
Imported Cheese: European cheeses for hotels, restaurants and retailers, most from Daily Dairy of the Netherlands: Gouda, Edam, white and coloured Cheddar, Emmental, Comté, Grana Padano, Pecorino Romano, young goat cheese, Danish blue, V.S.O.C Black Label aged Gouda, grated Parmesan and feta, plus processed cheese slices for burgers and sandwiches. Keep cheese refrigerated and wrapped, and cut hard cheeses to order so the cut faces don't dry out.
Italian Pasta: Dried Italian pasta for restaurants, hotels and retailers from Dedicato, Granoro's 100% Puglia line, and Donna Chiara: spaghetti, linguine, penne, fusilli, farfalloni, elbow macaroni, pappardelle, spinach tagliatelle, spaghetti vermicelli, spirali fantasia, cannelloni and gnocchi, plus semolina lasagna sheets. Match the shape to the sauce: long strands for oil-based and light tomato sauces, tubes and twists for thick and chunky ones, wide ribbons for rich ragù.
Japanese Products: Japanese pantry ingredients for sushi bars, Asian restaurants and hotels: yakinori seaweed sheets for sushi, panko breadcrumbs, tempura flour, wasabi powder, mirin, Japanese mayonnaise, black vinegar and soba noodles.
Local Sauces: Everyday sauces and seasonings for Sri Lankan kitchens and caterers: tomato sauce in economy, standard and premium grades, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce and chicken stock powder, for curries, stir-fries, fried rice, gravies and soups.
Mexican: Albertos flour tortillas in 10-inch (6 per pack) and 6-inch (8 per pack) sizes for burritos, wraps, quesadillas, tacos and fajitas. Warm tortillas briefly on a dry pan or griddle before filling so they stay soft and fold without cracking. For heat at the table, pair them with Tabasco pepper sauce from Seasonings & Sauce.
Packing Material: Food-service packaging and disposables: aluminium containers with lids in 750 ml and 1,200 ml for takeaway and catering, paper cups in 6, 8 and 12 oz, white cake cups, baking paper, and latex, vinyl and polyethylene gloves for food handling.
Pie Filling & Topping: Ready-to-use Acroyali fruit pie fillings in apple, blueberry, raspberry, red cherry and strawberry, each in a 50% and a 70% version, and Mavee's sweetened whipping creams. Fillings go straight into pies, tarts, turnovers, cheesecakes and Danish pastries, and save kitchens peeling, cooking and thickening fruit in-house.
Poultry: Frozen duck breast, boneless with the skin on, for restaurants and hotels. Score the skin and start it skin-side down in a cold pan to render the fat slowly, then finish in a hot oven. Stored and delivered frozen at −18 °C; thaw in the refrigerator before cooking.
Rice: Azizaa basmati rice from India in 5 kg and 20 kg bags, and Extra Long Grain Gold and Platinum 1121 for biryani and pilaf. Basmati cooks into long, separate, fragrant grains; rinsing until the water runs clear and a short soak before cooking help the grains lengthen without breaking.
Seasonings & Sauce: Sauces and condiments from around the world: Tabasco pepper sauce, sriracha, dark soy sauce and Tiparos fish sauce, for marinades, glazes, stir-fries, dips and the table.
Thai Products: Ingredients for Thai cooking: Mae Ploy green curry, red curry and tom yum pastes, Tiparos fish sauce, dark soy sauce, Mahachai pad thai rice noodles and Wai Wai rice vermicelli. With fresh herbs and coconut milk, they cover green and red curries, tom yum soup, pad thai and noodle salads.
